protocol.outer_cv: Same five shared CAD-stratified folds as v1/v2
protocol.inner_cv: Three target-stratified folds, same seeds as v2; all preprocessing fit in training partitions
protocol.selection_metric: Pooled inner OOF log loss, within each family
protocol.classification_threshold: Each fitted outer model uses an inner-OOF F1-selected threshold on 0.05..0.95 grid, same deterministic tie break as v2
protocol.calibration: No posthoc calibration fit in this bounded exploratory probe
protocol.selection_warning: These separate family development results cannot be selected by outer score and claimed as untouched final evaluation
protocol.portable_export: No tree JSON runtime exported; pipelines saved for reproducibility only
protocol.auc_ci: 1000 patient resamples of fixed OOF scores, conditional and excludes retraining/protocol selection
